frontmatter.name: Perf and motion
frontmatter.overview: The public site feels slow because AppShell blocks on a full Supabase fetch plus a multi-second boot overlay, then every navigation waits on AnimatePresence `mode="wait"` plus a lazy chunk. Motion already exists (Framer Motion Reveal/Hero) but is too subtle, often skipped, or drowned out by that delay. Fix the load/nav path first, then make public-site motion more perceptible with the libraries already in the project.
